title: Fig. 22: GT-4 Manned Space Flight Network (Gemini) world tracking map
description: World relief map titled "GT-4 MANNED SPACE FLIGHT NETWORK GEMINI" showing sinusoidal orbital ground tracks crossing the globe and circles marking the coverage areas of tracking stations in North America, the Atlantic, Africa, the Indian Ocean, Australia and the Pacific. The map is printed sideways on the page and labeled "FIG. 22" in NASA document M-913-65-04 (5/24/65).
